# Codex Rate Monitor v0.3.3

## 中文

### 修复

- 修复托盘「立即刷新」未更新重置券数量的问题。
- 修复托盘提示信息不完整的问题；各额度、更新时间与重置券详情现在分行显示。

### 改进

- 重置券默认每 15 分钟查询；确认额度重置后立即补查，并合并重复请求。
- 重置券进度条跟随「剩余／已用」方向和颜色阈值；文字保持常规颜色，仅在 3 天内到期时改变卡片底色。

## English

### Fixes

- Fixed **Refresh now** in the tray menu not updating reset-credit counts.
- Fixed incomplete tray tooltips; each quota, the update time, and reset-credit details now appear on separate lines.

### Improvements

- Reset credits are queried every 15 minutes by default and immediately after a confirmed quota reset, with duplicate requests merged.
- Reset-credit bars follow the Remaining / Used direction and color thresholds. Text keeps its normal colors, and the card background changes only within 3 days of expiry.

[Full changelog / 完整变更](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.3.2...v0.3.3)
